title: FRANK channel adapter health
description: CH-01 (FRANK-§8E). Truthful health report for a channel adapter, mirroring the Buzz adapter posture: healthy is false whenever the adapter cannot reach the platform or cannot deliver, with the reason in detail. Health is never reported true to be polite.

healthy.description: Adapter reachable and able to post to the platform.

connected.description: Adapter's live connection/polling state at check time.

platform.description: Adapter key of the platform, e.g. 'telegram'.

pendingDeliveryDepth.description: Outbound items buffered for retry while the platform is unreachable.
